jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Observability Platform)
jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE?**

Being the daughter company of Swisscom - leading telecommunications company and one of the most sustainable and innovative companies in Switzerland - we share the same values, vision and goals.

As a trustworthy and efficient Swisscom IT service partner, we create valuable customer experiences. We work in a strong collaboration with our Partners in Switzerland and attract and retain high performers.

**We're expanding our footprint in Riga and actively seeking 50+ DevOps Engineers to join our growing teams within this year.**

We invite driven professionals to join us, grow with us, and help shape the future.

**The Product & Team**We are an interdisciplinary, international team developing and operating the standard application and infrastructure monitoring stack used by Swisscom’s decentralised DevOps teams. We deliver our capabilities as SaaS products – self-developed services, integrated cloud services, and integrated third-party SaaS products.

Our observability stack includes metrics (Cortex/Grafana) and distributed tracing (Tempo). Beyond building the platform, we consult and support the DevOps teams in the value streams so they can apply monitoring best practices, accelerate their value creation, and meet the quality targets for their products.

You will strengthen our growing Riga presence, working closely with the team in Switzerland. We work in an agile setup, collaborate across disciplines through the whole lifecycle, respond flexibly to new requirements, and stay calm and solution-focused during operational challenges.

**As a Senior Full Stack Engineer you will:**

* Work across the entire stack – product and technology – taking end-to-end ownership of services throughout the product lifecycle

* Further develop our monitoring SaaS stack (Cortex/Grafana for metrics, Tempo for distributed tracing, Loki/Alloy for logs) and help set its technical direction

* Build and run **fleet management at scale** – Alloy agent configuration, in-fleet config validation on GitLab push events, credential delivery, and agent handshakes

* Help build **and** operate our alerting platform (Jira Service Management) – including auth, Twilio integration, and event streaming (Kafka/NATS)

* Drive full-stack feature work – APIs and UI as well as backend services – and raise the bar on design, quality, and reliability

* Deliver engineering-heavy operations at scale – tenant migrations, Cortex upgrades, and cluster upgrades (Gateway API, network policies, MetalLB)

* Build CI/CD pipelines and automation (GitLab-CI, ArgoCD, AWS CDK) and help implement the monitoring strategy for workloads on-prem and in the AWS Cloud

* Support the team in operational daily work and take part in the on-call rotation

* Evaluate and apply suitable AI use cases – e.g. agentic AI/MCP tooling, anomaly detection, automated log analysis – while ensuring secure data handling, traceability, and human oversight

* Take technical lead on initiatives – set direction, coordinate work across the team, and drive it to completion

* Mentor team members, share your knowledge with users, and help grow the engineering strength of the Riga group

* Contribute to technical decisions, architecture, and cross-team alignment with Switzerland

**Who you are & how we work**You work independently on complex features and initiatives, and you are equally willing to support the team in end-of-day and operational work. You are self-driven about developing further on the job – and you help others around you develop too.

You can balance high demands and stay comfortable when not everything can be done at once – you have the courage to live with ‘the gap’ and prioritize well. You bring a high sense for quality and the judgement to tell where strictly following processes and standards is a must, and where creativity and exploration are possible and welcome.

**What we offer:**

* **Salary from 4900 to 6500 EUR monthly gross**

* 80 EUR monthly cell phone and internet allowance

* Flexible working hours and a hybrid working model, with a minimum of 2 days per week in the office

* Ergonomic home office allowance in value of 500 EUR

* Possibility to work abroad for 4 weeks each year

* Health Insurance – includes gym or pool/aquatic fitness membership, issued after 1 month, and covers consultations with a psychologist or psychotherapist

* Optics (200 EUR every 2 years)

* 24 working days of annual paid holiday per year

* 5 dedicated paid learning day’s annually

* Gym membership or swimming pool/water aerobics membership

* Day off on your birthday or names day

* 1 day off for social activities (voluntary project, adopting an animal)​

* Collaborative, friendly and driven work environment

* Work on innovations, cutting edge technologies and in autonomous high performance teams

* Parking options

* Continuous development environment that fosters your growth (conferences, cross-department experience sharing, learning platforms etc.)

* Annual salary review

**Must have:**

* Degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

* Several years of professional experience as a software or platform engineer

* Previous tech lead or technical leadership experience – setting technical direction, coordinating a team, and taking ownership of larger initiatives end to end

* Proven software development skills in Go

* Experience working on Linux platforms and in cloud environments

* Experience with containers and orchestration (Kubernetes / CaaS / PaaS)

* Ability to build CI/CD pipelines and automation (e.g. GitLab-CI, ArgoCD)

* Scripting skills (e.g. Bash, Python)

* Strong troubleshooting skills in complex VM, cloud, and hybrid environments

* A track record of working with a high degree of independence and owning significant pieces of a product or platform

* Experience mentoring or coaching engineers, and a willingness to continue doing so

* Agile mindset and experience with Scrum, Kanban, or a related framework

* Very good English, spoken and written (our users and documentation are in English)

* Strong sense of ownership and a desire to keep learning

* Open-minded, curious, and communicative personality

**Nice to have:**

* Interest and/or experience in IT architecture, and willingness to take on the Security Champion role in the team

* IT security experience (threat modelling, security concepts, data classification)

* Experience with AWS cloud services

* Experience with monitoring, distributed tracing, or log analytics (Prometheus/Cortex, Grafana, Tempo, Loki, Splunk, Elastic)

* Experience with event streaming / messaging (Kafka, NATS)

* IAM integration knowledge (SAML, LDAP, Active Directory)

* Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) or equivalent

* Experience with AI-assisted development or operations tools (coding assistants, anomaly detection, automated log analysis)

* German language skills (not required)

**What makes this a senior role**Compared to our mid-level Full Stack Engineer profile, the senior role is defined by a larger scope of independence, proven Go expertise, previous tech lead or technical leadership experience, and the ability to shape technical decisions and architecture. We expect you to take technical lead on initiatives, mentor colleagues, raise quality standards, and potentially take on the Security Champion role.

jobs.title: Platform Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
About the RoleAt Frankenburg, you will help bring next-generation systems from concept to operational capability. As a **Platform Integration Engineer**, you will work at the heart of our integration efforts, collaborating with internal engineering teams and external platform partners to ensure our systems are successfully integrated across land, sea, and air platforms.

You will join an exceptional team of leading experts in technology and national defence, building next-generation defence missile systems for the free world. You will work in a fast-paced environment where your contribution directly shapes how our technologies are integrated, tested, and fielded. If you thrive on solving complex engineering challenges and want to make a tangible impact on defence capabilities, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

* **Platform Integration** Work closely with internal engineering teams and external partners to define, manage, and verify system interfaces.

* **Artifact Generation**Author and update technical integration documentation, including Integration Specifications, Interface Control Documents (ICDs), Test Plans, and Trial Reports.

* **Hands-on Integration & Testing**Conduct physical, electrical, and functional integration testing in laboratories, HIL environments, and field trials.

* **Data Capture & Analysis**Operate diagnostic and telemetry equipment during testing, capturing and analysing data to support root-cause investigations and system verification.

* **Field Deployment Support** Assist with the preparation, installation, and deployment of test assets and equipment at various trial locations.

* **Cross-Platform Support**Support integration activities across land, sea, and air programs, including hardware installation, troubleshooting, and engineering trials.

We Would Love You to Have

* **Educational Background**Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical discipline.

* **Experience**Experience in system integration, testing, verification, or validation within a complex engineering environment, ideally involving multidisciplinary hardware and software systems.

* **Technical Skills**Strong understanding of system integration, interface management, and technical documentation, with the ability to support testing, troubleshooting, and root-cause investigations in laboratory or field environments.

* **Soft Skills**Proactive and adaptable, with strong problem-solving and collaboration skills, able to work effectively across multiple programs, domains, and engineering teams.

* **Mission Alignment**Strong alignment with our mission to build affordable and mass-manufacturable defence technologies — ensuring every euro spent moves us closer to our goal.

* **Security Clearance**Willingness to undergo a background check as a condition of employment.

Our ValuesOur mission is ambitious, and it takes a team that works with the same intensity.

* **Own the Mission: Mission first. Always.**We choose impact — we focus on what moves the mission forward fastest instead of “nice-to-haves". We fix it now — when delays or problems appear, we step up, rally the right people, and solve them immediately. We keep momentum — when time matters, we stay focused and move forward without waiting for perfect conditions.

* **Strive for More: Dare more. Do more. Achieve the impossible.**We challenge the status quo — we question, test, and improve instead of accepting “the usual way.” We embrace discomfort — we step outside comfort zones and turn challenges into growth. We anticipate the future — we build solutions that scale and set higher standards each time.

* **Build with Trust: Be open. Keep promises.**We walk the talk — what we say, we do. No excuses, no exceptions. We share openly — we communicate clearly and early, even when the news is hard. We own outcomes — we admit errors quickly, fix them, and prevent them from repeating.

Ready to Make a Real Impact?Apply now! The deadline is **October 31, 2026,** but we review applications and reach out to qualified candidates continuously.

jobs.description:
**About us:**

**Planner 5D** is a global hub for home design, uniting over 100+ million users in 230 territories around our planet (yes, we have 2 users connecting from Antarctica each month!). Our platform simplifies the home renovation process from concept to execution, and this process has never been more straightforward with our [cutting-edge software](https://tool.planner5d.com/about-us-2023). jobs.title: Senior Fullstack App Developer
jobs.description:
**Joining Team Norse is more than getting a job. It is all about belonging.**

Always dreamt of doing things differently? Join us in Comtech at Norse Atlantic Airways, where we build the digital products behind a challenger airline.

We think differently and we act differently. We are not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom and test new ideas. We are a data-driven, product-first organization powered by a small, tight-knit team of developers, product managers and data scientists — plus a few potatoes*.

If these prospects inspire you, then we want to talk to you!

*Potatoes: a Norwegian term for people who can do a little bit of everything.

**Why This Role is Exciting**

Our Flutter app is at the heart of Norse's digital experience, and we're looking for someone to take real ownership of it. You'll be the driving force behind the mobile app while working shoulder-to-shoulder with a small engineering team — which means your day won't stop at the app. In a lean team, the best people wear more than one hat, so you'll also jump in to support the wider stack: our GraphQL layer, our .NET / C# backend services, and the integrations that hold it all together. Your heart is in app development, but your reach goes across the whole product.

This role sits within Comtech and reports to the Head of Ecom and Product.**Responsibilities and Duties**

Flutter App Development (your main focus)

* Own the design, development and maintenance of our cross-platform mobile app in Flutter and Dart, delivering a high-performing, scalable and user-friendly experience on both iOS and Android.

* Drive the app's architecture and set best practices for state management, testing and release, keeping the codebase clean and maintainable.

* Partner with UX/UI designers to build intuitive, engaging interfaces, and iterate based on user testing and experimentation.

* Optimize app performance — load times, responsiveness and stability — across a wide range of devices.

Backend & Fullstack Support

* Roll up your sleeves alongside the rest of the team to support our general stack, contributing to backend services built with .NET Core and C#.

* Design, consume and extend GraphQL APIs that connect the app and web front-ends to our backend systems.

* Help design robust, secure and reliable integrations, ensuring smooth communication between the app, the backend and third-party services.

* Support and unblock fellow engineers across the stack — reviewing code, pairing and stepping in wherever the team needs an extra pair of hands.

Architecture & Collaboration

* Take ownership of end-to-end delivery, from architecture through to deployment, following clean architecture principles.

* Work within Agile Scrum, participating in sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives with product managers, designers and fellow engineers.

* Collaborate closely with a cross-functional team to ship a best-in-class product, fast.

Code Review, Mentorship & Innovation

* Conduct thorough code reviews and champion high coding standards across the app and the wider stack.

* Mentor and support other developers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and collaboration.

* Stay ahead of emerging technologies and industry trends, proposing and implementing ideas that push our products forward.

**What You Bring to the Table**

* 5+ years of software development experience, with a strong focus on mobile development in Flutter and Dart.

* Proven experience shipping and maintaining production mobile apps on iOS and Android.

* Solid backend experience with .NET Core and C#, and comfort working across a fullstack codebase.

* Hands-on experience with GraphQL (designing, consuming or extending APIs).

* Experience with RESTful APIs and integrating third-party services.

* Familiarity with cloud platforms, preferably Azure.

* A passion for clean, maintainable and scalable code, and strong problem-solving and communication skills.

* Experience working in Agile teams, and a startup mindset that thrives in a small, high-ownership team.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (desired but not required).

* Take ownership of assigned infrastructure tasks and contribute effectively to day-to-day operations

* Build a strong understanding of the company’s critical systems and infrastructure dependencies

* Identify and assess technical issues independently and propose practical solutions

* Contribute to infrastructure maintenance, troubleshooting, deployment, and system reliability

* Work effectively with Development, Architecture, Security, Data, and other technical teams

* Proactively identify infrastructure risks, problems, and improvement opportunities

* Initiate and implement improvements to infrastructure and systems

* Contribute to ensuring the continuous operation of business-critical systems and the infrastructure team’s ability to support growing business needs

* Experience with self-managed monitoring, alerting, and logging

* Experience maintaining and configuring Jenkins CI/CD pipelines

* Hands-on experience with GCP, Terraform, and Ansible

* Hands-on experience with self-managed PostgreSQL clusters

* Solid understanding of networking principles

* Proficiency in shell scripting, Python or Go

* Install, upgrade, maintain, and test disaster recovery and backups for self-managed PostgreSQL clusters

* Oversee and optimize Kubernetes cluster operations and deployment pipelines

* Work closely with development teams to support feature releases and ensure technology supports business goals

* Create clear technical documentation and keep system architecture documentation up to date

* Communicate openly and effectively with both technical colleagues and other stakeholders

* Enjoy collaborating across Development, Architecture, Security, Data, and other teams

* Wait for detailed instructions before addressing technical problems

* Avoid working with existing or complex infrastructure

* Prefer maintaining the status quo rather than continuously improving systems

* Strong communication is particularly important for success in this role, as the position requires extensive cooperation across technical teams.

* The opportunity to work with Kubernetes, GCP, Terraform, Ansible, PostgreSQL, Jenkins, and modern infrastructure practices

* Close collaboration with experienced Development, Architecture, Security, and Data professionals

* A results-driven culture with trust, ownership, and the freedom to improve how we work

* Health insurance after the probation period

* Employer contributions to the INDEXO 3rd Pension Pillar after the probation period

* Predictive Index assessment

* Potential practical task

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Edurio is on its way to improving education quality globally and we're looking for great people to join us on the journey.

We help schools and school groups survey their parents, pupils, and staff to build organisations where people thrive. We currently work with over 2000 schools in the United Kingdom and Latvia and are planning to grow significantly in the next year.

As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you would take a problem the product team has framed, decide how it gets built, build it with the help of AI agents, verify it, and answer for it once it is live.

# The development team and how we work

You would join a development team of five, and growing: four developers and a QA engineer. Product is a separate team of four. You would report to our Engineering Manager. Our Principal Engineer owns the architecture, the database schema and the standard we build to.

Our developers direct coding agents and verify what comes back, so writing code by hand is a small part of the job. Everybody here invests their time in exploring AI, new tools and agentic development, and we expect people to experiment rather than wait for permission. However, our engineers own and understand the code at a senior level so we are not looking for pure vibecoders.

# Your responsibilities

* Take the work end to end: the technical design, the full stack build, the release, and how it behaves in production

* Direct and correct coding agents, and share what works so the rest of the team can use it

* Build the tests, the error output and the checks that let the agent correct itself and let the rest of us trust the result

* Review colleagues' changes where human judgement is needed: design, consequences, hidden coupling and security

* Respond first when something you built breaks, and own the fix, the alerting and the runbook

* Document what you build, and keep the agent context files for your area current

# What we're looking for

* Experience building and running web applications, front end and back end

* Strong use of coding agents in your daily work

* Ability to verify your own work before anybody else sees it

* Ability to write a technical design that a colleague or an agent can build from

* Ownership of your code - you can justify your choices and explain and defend the code you submit. You own and understand your code even where it was written agentically.

* Excellent verbal and written English skills

* Interest in being part of a strong team culture and work collaboratively with other departments

Useful, but we do not expect all of these:

* Vue, TypeScript, or AWS serverless

* Experience or interest in the EdTech sector

* Experience or interest in UI/UX or design

This is probably not for you if:

* You want a detailed specification handed to you, with the thinking already done

* You want to pass on what the agent produced without checking it

* You want somebody else to own the code once it is merged

# The attitudes we'd like to see

* **Ownership:** You do what you said you would do, and take responsibility for how it lands with the client - not just for completing the task

* **Genuine care:** You build real relationships with clients and colleagues, assume good intentions, and do the right thing rather than the easy thing

* **Openness:** You communicate honestly, don't shy away from difficult conversations, and give and receive feedback well

* **Growth:** You're curious about how things could work better, and you act on what you learn rather than defaulting to how it's always been done

# What we offer

* Experience in growing in an international company and a chance to have an impact on education quality

* Feedback-based work culture which highly values transparency and team well-being

* Flexible working hours, and hybrid working (we have a preference for candidates who want to spend a part of their week in our cosy office in central Riga).

* Gross salary: from 4500 EUR per month depending on experience, as well as company share options, paid phone plan, and health insurance.

Edurio is on its way to improving education quality globally and we're looking for great people to join us on the journey.

* Help the team solve technical problems, answer questions, and find practical solutions

* Develop a modular codebase, conduct thorough code reviews, follow best practices and coding guidelines

* Work closely with both technical and non-technical teams

* Support hiring as the team grows

,

* 7+ years of experience in Android development (including Leadership experience)

* Extensive experience with Kotlin and Java

* Extensive knowledge of the Android ecosystem (Android SDK, Jetpack, Dagger, and common libraries)

* Experience with SQL, SQLite, and Room

* Experience with concurrency and asynchronous programming (Kotlin Coroutines and RxJava)

* Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, XML, Git, and Protobuf

* Very good understanding of software design, code quality, and testing practices

* Ability to write clean, readable, and maintainable code

* Ability to make technical decisions and explain trade-offs

* Provide mentoring and constructive feedback to developers

* Strong sense of ownership

* Clear and concise communication

* Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical teams

* Experience with in-app payments and subscriptions

* Fluent English

,

* Experience with 2D/3D graphics (Canvas, OpenGL, Vulkan, or Google Filament)

**Visa sponsorship is available if you hold primary residence with work authorization.**

* **Risk Management:** identifying potential risks in the testing process and implementing corrective measures to mitigate them

* **Quality Assurance:** ensuring the quality and functionality of the product by implementing rigorous testing procedures and standards.

* **Test Documentation and Reporting:** preparing detailed test documentation, including test cases, and generating reports on testing activities and progress

* **Defect Tracking and Management:** implementing and maintaining defect tracking systems to ensure timely identification, communication, and resolution of issues, and coordinating with development teams to address any defects found

* **Coordinating with Stakeholders:** liaising with developers, project managers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and address any issues that arise during testing

* **Continuous Improvement:** identifying opportunities for process improvement and implementing best practices to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of testing activities

* **Exceptional Communication and Interpersonal Skills:** strong ability to communicate effectively across diverse teams and stakeholders, including DevOps engineers, with a personable and approachable demeanor that facilitates collaboration and understanding

* **Proficiency in English**: fluent in English, both written and spoken, to articulate testing insights and coordinate effectively with international teams.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Autoscaler
jobs.description:
Why Cast AI?**Cast AI is the leading Application Performance Automation (APA) platform**, enabling customers to cut cloud costs, improve performance, and boost productivity – automatically.Built originally for Kubernetes, Cast AI goes beyond cost and observability by delivering real-time, autonomous optimization across any cloud environment. The platform continuously analyzes workloads, rightsizes resources, and rebalances clusters without manual intervention, ensuring applications run faster, more reliably, and more efficiently.Headquartered in Miami, Florida, Cast AI has employees in more than 32 countries worldwide and supports some of the world’s most innovative teams running their applications on all major cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments. Over 2,100 companies already rely on Cast - from BMW and Akamai to Hugging Face and NielsenIQ.What’s next? Backed by our $108M Series C, we’re doubling down on making APA the new standard for DevOps and MLOps, and everything in between.

These are the core values that hold us all together:**PRACTICE CUSTOMER OBSESSION.** Focus on the customer journey and work backwards. Strive to deliver customer value and continuously solve customer problems. Listen to customer feedback, act, and iterate to improve customer experience.

**LEAD.** Take ownership and lead through action. Think and act on behalf of the entire company to build long-term value across team boundaries.

**DEVELOP AND HIRE THE BEST.** Strive to raise the performance bar by continuously investing in yourself, the team and by hiring the best possible candidates for every position. Drive towards personal development and professional growth, and mentor others to raise the collective bar.

**EXPECT AND ADVOCATE CHANGE.** Strive to innovate and accept the inevitable change that comes with innovation. Constantly welcome new ideas and opinions. Share insights responsibly with unwavering openness, honesty, and respect. Once a path is chosen, be ready to disagree and commit to a direction.

**Autoscaler** – Automates Kubernetes node autoscaling to optimize clusters, balance workloads, remove underutilized nodes, and dynamically allocate capacity in real-time, thereby reducing cluster costs by half.

Here are some of the tools we use daily:

* **Languages:** GoLang (primary), Python (secondary for some cases)

* **Cloud & Orchestration:** Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Azure
